content.title: Letter O | Octopus, Orange, Owl, Oval - Learn the Letter O
content.text: O - Learn the Letter O - Octopus, Orange, Owl, Oval Learn the Alphabet’s letter O with this fun and simple video for kids. With a focus on the letter O, we give four clear examples with the letter’s phonetic sound. -------------- Lyrics: The letter O, so round and neat, O is for Orange, o o Orange, so juicy and sweet. The letter O, so round and bright, O is for Owl, o o Owl, Owls come out at night. The letter O, so round and neat, O is for Octopus, o o Octopus, they have eight feet. The letter O, so round and fine, O is for Oval, o o Oval, Ovals always shine.
